acceptance: A pytest-xdist release containing the fix for #1378 is locked
A worker killed mid-session under --dist loadscope lets the session finish (reproduce with a test that kills its worker, or cite the upstream test)
--max-worker-restart=0 is removed from the three workflows, or kept with the reason recorded
Decision gate: blocked until upstream releases; check the changelog first
description: PR #4121 added --max-worker-restart=0 to the medium-tier pytest command in ci.yml, trunk.yml and trunk-coverage.yml because pytest-xdist 3.8.0 with --dist loadscope cannot finish a session after a worker dies (pytest-dev/pytest-xdist#1378; fixed on master by #1324 and #1328, unreleased on 2026-11-11). The flag turns a 25-minute hang into a fast failure that names the test, but it also means one crashed worker ends the shard.
